_about: John Morley, Viscount Morley of Blackburn (1838-1923), liberal man of letters, historian of the French Enlightenment: On Compromise (Macmillan; this edition first printed 1886, the etext from the 1908 printing); Voltaire (Macmillan, 1886); Rousseau, 2 vols. in one (Macmillan; first printed in this form 1886, the etext from the 1905 reprint); Diderot and the Encyclopaedists, vol. II (Macmillan; new edition 1886, the etext from the 1905 reprint); Burke, the English Men of Letters life (Macmillan; first printed 1888, the etext from the 1907 reprint). Clean Gutenberg texts. Wanted: Diderot and the Encyclopaedists vol. I (PG 15098 would not download). The Critical Miscellanies, split essay by essay on Gutenberg, are not taken. US public domain. No uids minted.
